report.headline: A below-average-usage EuroLeague wing projects to an even smaller NBA role, and the model has nothing reliable to say about his shooting efficiency

projection.text: Projected usage in the NBA is 12.8%, down from 15.6% in the EuroLeague and roughly 1.35 standard deviations below the league's 20.1% average usage (sd 5.4%); this projection is informative because the model beats a trivial league-average baseline on usage (3.2% MAE vs 4.2%).

risks.text: His EuroLeague usage rate of 15.6% sat 0.97 standard deviations below the league average, a notably lower offensive role than the typical EL->NBA mover, whose cohort of 61 transitions averaged +0.46 sd above their own league's average before moving.
Projected NBA usage of 12.8% is about 1.35 standard deviations below the league's 20.1% average (sd 5.4%), pointing to a fringe offensive role if the point estimate holds.
He was 27.0 years old in the source season, older than the typical mover, leaving less developmental runway to grow into a larger role.
The true shooting projection of 53.4% should not be treated as informative: the model's error on this metric (4.5%) is worse than simply predicting the league average (4.3%).

strengths.text: Played a consistent rotation role in the EuroLeague, logging 934 minutes across 36 games with per-75 marks of 10.1 points, 2.2 assists, and 5.6 rebounds.
Protected the ball well for a lower-usage player, with a 13.3% turnover rate.
Took 44.9% of his shot attempts from three, consistent with a floor-spacing offensive role.
Shot 55.8% true shooting in the source season, only 0.45 standard deviations below the EuroLeague average despite his modest offensive share.

uncertainty.text: The 80% interval for projected usage (7.5%–18.2%) spans about two standard deviations of the NBA usage distribution, so the model can say this is a low-usage profile but not pin down where within that range he lands; the true shooting projection (53.4%) carries no information at all, since the model's error there (4.5%) is worse than simply guessing the league average (4.3%).
